listing.name: Doom 3: Resurrection of Evil (classic) (dhewm3)
listing.summary: Use the official dhewm3 Windows player for classic Resurrection of Evil with your own base-game and expansion files. Keep its external profile backed up.

steps.title: Prepare your original game
steps.instruction: Before Play, copy only base/pak000.pk4 through base/pak008.pk4 from your own classic Doom 3 installation patched to 1.3.1 into the matching base folder beside dhewm3.exe. Also copy your own Resurrection of Evil d3xp/pak000.pk4 and d3xp/pak001.pk4 into d3xp beside the player. Both the complete base game and expansion are required; the maintained launch arguments select d3xp. Keep the original installation separately. BFG Edition is a different product; do not copy its files or old engine executables/DLLs over this runtime. Prepare these files yourself and check the edition against the upstream instructions; Portcove does not verify their original-game identity. The official Windows player is 32-bit and runs on 64-bit Windows through Windows compatibility support. Keep the package's own DLLs and resources together. Its optional mods and widescreen-GUI downloads are separate; customized runtime or mod layouts can keep an external registration.

steps.title: Keep an existing prepared copy
steps.instruction: Keep a working custom copy registered with dhewm3.exe, its actual runtime folder as working directory, and its own launch details. To read originals from another installation, use three separate argument lines: +set, fs_basepath, then the absolute folder containing base and any d3xp data. Select Resurrection of Evil with three more separate lines: +set, fs_game, d3xp. You and upstream retain replacement and data ownership for that external copy; removing its registration preserves its files. This alternative does not make Portcove manage or migrate its originals, saves or runtime.

steps.title: Keep your saves and existing copy
steps.instruction: Normal Windows saves, settings, screenshots, demos and logs are in your actual Documents/My Games/dhewm3 profile, with separate base and d3xp scopes. Back up that external profile and your original game separately before changing engines or versions. Existing customized copies keep their own launch details and runtime owner.
